quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangsu Novoray New Material annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Capacity (annual report): in 2025 the company started the 'ultra-pure spherical powder for high-performance high-speed substrates' project, which on completion adds 3600 tonnes a year of ultra-pure spherical silica meeting the filler requirements of M8, M9, M10-and-above next-generation high-speed substrates for high-performance servers (budget RMB 423,239,800.00, 12.36% complete at end-2025), and plans a 'high-thermal-conductivity high-purity spherical powder' project adding 16000 tonnes a year of spherical alumina. The company says the substrate project will ease the current situation in which its capacity struggles to match the market's rapid expansion for M7-and-above substrate fillers, and the alumina project will break its current capacity bottleneck. Construction in progress rose to RMB 93,076,790.97 (+318.04%), mainly from that project and the IC advanced functional powder R&D center (budget RMB 100,000,000.00, 17.99% complete; main structure essentially built, expected in use in 2026); the advanced-packaging high-performance spherical powder project (budget RMB 50,000,000.00) was 69.9% complete.
quarterly_data.figure: 3600 tonnes/yr ultra-pure spherical silica (M8-M10 substrates) under construction; 16000 tonnes/yr spherical alumina planned

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangsu Novoray New Material annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Company (annual report): in 2025 it completed new-product expansion at leading underfill (UF), LMC and DAF customers in advanced packaging; several high-performance products for electronic circuit substrates completed technical verification, product listing and batch delivery; and several high-performance spherical alumina products entered leading thermal-material customers and their core formulations. The revenue share of spherical silica sold into high-performance copper-clad laminates rose in 2025, and higher-end products' share of revenue is rising.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangsu Novoray New Material annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: R&D (annual report): 2025 R&D spend RMB 64,165,904.08, up 6.23%, 5.75% of revenue (6.29% in 2024); 103 R&D staff. Projects: ultra-pure spherical silica with Df<=0.0003 for very-low-loss high-speed substrates (M9 LVL and above), aimed at servers with 224Gbps-and-above transmission, reached the industrialization stage; Top cut 3um spherical silica for 2.5D advanced-packaging underfill is at the laboratory stage; spherical silica for LMC entered the engineering stage; submicron spherical alumina for UF, aluminium nitride and boron nitride for thermal interface materials, and submicron spherical silica for advanced packaging (build-up film, HDI) reached the industrialization stage.

quarterly_data.quarter: Jiangsu Novoray New Material annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-22-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 business plan (annual report): the company will shift from 'scale expansion' to 'value leadership'. It will defend share and profit in its core products (angular silica, general spherical silica, spherical alumina) while special task teams target leading-customer certification and volume supply in advanced packaging, high-performance circuit substrates and high-thermal-conductivity materials for its high-growth products (submicron spherical silica and alumina, Low-alpha spherical silica and alumina, liquid-phase spherical silica); it will bring its capacity projects to completion and full output, build more high-performance product lines, and expand capacity for more products depending on market conditions.
